description: Shared automation filter corpus. The Rust matcher (crates/tiktools-core/src/services/automation/filters.rs) is the contract; the TypeScript test-support matcher (src/automation/behavior/testing/filter-matcher.ts) must agree on every case. Expectations are derived from the Rust semantics, never from running either matcher. Numbers are limited to values whose JSON text is identical in both runtimes (no integral floats such as 5.0, no exponents).
